items: Mazboot hai, aasani se nahi toot'ta, aur rubbing (ragar) aur wear and tear (ghisaav) bardasht karta hai.
Elasticity (lachak) ki wajah se khinch jata hai.
Is ki satah phisalne wali hai, is liye friction (ragar) kam karti hai.
Aam tor par teil, kai solvents (jin mein cheezein ghulti hain) aur alkalis is par asar nahi karte.
Is ka melting point (pighalne ka temperature) zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: Nylon ki kaun si properties ise gears aur bearings ke liye suitable (theek) banati hain?
blocks.explanation: Is ki mazbooti aur wear and tear bardasht karne ki taqat, aur is ki phisalne wali satah jo friction kam karti hai.

items: Nylon: mazboot, lachakdar, kam friction, teil aur alkalis se mehfooz, zyada melting point.
